screen-collarch.technical-specification: A LiveView screen collection fronting link administration: one list view, one creation form, both reading and writing through link_admin's public surface only.
screen-collarch.public-surface: Rendered routes /links and /links/new; no public API beyond the rendered pages themselves.
screen-collarch.private-surface: Internal form-state assigns; nothing another collection reads.
screen-collarch.failure-surface: A failed validation re-renders the form with the error inline; a failed retire redirects back to the list unchanged.
screen-collarch.policies: Every mutating action confirms before it retires a link, since retirement is immediate and not soft-deleted.

subcomponent.name: LinkListLive
subcomponent.purpose: Lists every live link an owner has created.

owned-invariants.invariant: A retired link never appears in the list.
The list reflects a create or retire within one page load.

primary-operations.operation: Render the current owner's live links.
Retire a link from the list.

subcomponent.responsibilities: Presents link_admin's own link inventory; owns no backend state itself.

subcomponent.name: LinkCreateLive
subcomponent.purpose: Takes a target URL and mints a short code for it.

owned-invariants.invariant: A submission with an invalid target URL never reaches link_admin.
A successful submission always redirects to the list.

primary-operations.operation: Validate a target URL client-side before submit.
Submit a validated URL to link_admin.
Redirect to the list on success.

subcomponent.responsibilities: Owns the creation form's own client-side validation only.
